Kennels

For your dog

From the kennels’ Facebook page and what owners write on Google.

Spacious kennels

Indoor and outdoor kennels, cooled in summer and heated in winter. One owner writes they are good sized and really clean.

Private dog park

More playtime outside in the dog park, as the Facebook page says, with paddling pools, as the photos show.

Day care too

The Facebook page lists the kennels as a dog day care center as well.

At Rosewood

Photos from the Google listing.

How owners describe a stay

Taken from what owners write in their Google reviews.

News during the stay

One owner got info, photos and videos of their dog very often during a two week stay.

Lots of play

Another writes that the dogs had a lot of fun and long time playing.

Peace of mind

A third writes that now they have no worries leaving their dog when they travel.

Book early for the holidays

At Christmas, Easter and in summer the kennels take only a limited number of dogs, so each dog gets more attention and playtime, as the Facebook page says. St. Raphael Street, Agioi Trimithias. Call 99 611773.
